# Reader's Digest

> Reader's Digest is a trusted lifestyle magazine and content platform offering daily articles, advice, entertainment, and resources across home, food, travel, money, humor, and general knowledge.

Founded in 1922, Reader's Digest serves millions of readers with curated content spanning practical life advice, entertaining stories, puzzles, and news. The site functions as a general-interest lifestyle hub with both editorial content and community-driven features.

## Core Lifestyle Sections

- [Reader's Digest: Official Site to Subscribe & Find Great Reads](https://www.rd.com): Reader's Digest homepage with daily stories, jokes, advice and subscription options
- [Home - Home Tips, Hacks, Cleaning, DIY & More](https://www.rd.com/home): Cleaning, organizing, DIY hacks and home decor tips
- [Food - Healthy Food & Eating, Food News & Recipes](https://www.rd.com/food): Recipes, healthy eating guides and shopping tips
- [Travel - Travel Tips, Attractions & More](https://www.rd.com/travel): Vacation planning, destinations and travel advice
- [Money - Management, Budgeting, Retirement, Tips](https://www.rd.com/money): Financial advice, budgeting strategies and retirement planning

## Entertainment & Humor

- [Funny - Cartoons, Pictures, Jokes, Puns & More](https://www.rd.com/funny): Jokes, puns, cartoons and funny stories for daily laughs
- [Fun Brain Games, Puzzles and Quizzes for Everyone](https://www.rd.com/article/brain-games-quizzes-puzzles): Interactive brain games, riddles, quizzes and word games
- [85 Best Spring Jokes for Kids and Parents](https://www.rd.com/article/spring-jokes): Seasonal jokes and puns for families and children

## Knowledge & Community

- [Knowledge - Brain Games, Etiquette, Facts, Grammar](https://www.rd.com/knowledge): Educational content on facts, grammar, psychology and etiquette
- [Nicest Places - Nicest Places in America](https://www.rd.com/real-life-stories/nicest-places): Community stories and inspiring features about kindest places in America
- [The Nicest Places in America 2026](https://www.rd.com/article/the-nicest-places-in-america-2026): Annual awards recognizing the kindest communities across America

## News & Seasonal Content

- [The Latest News for Entertainment, Home, Work & More](https://www.rd.com/news): Trending lifestyle and entertainment news aggregator
- [Holidays - National Holidays, Weird Holidays](https://www.rd.com/holidays): Holiday guides for celebration planning and traditions

## Travel & Transportation

- [Airlines - Travel & Flying Tips](https://www.rd.com/travel/airlines): Flying tips, airline fees and passenger etiquette guidance
- [Stranded Abroad During an Emergency? Here's What to Do ASAP](https://www.rd.com/article/what-to-do-stranded-abroad): Emergency travel guide and evacuation procedures for international travelers
